craft_notes: Sthāyin: śṛṅgāra-adbhuta of lovely emission; vyabhicāri rati-vismaya at moon-touched sport. Sanskrit-first: parollāsa-unmukhya per UNC (kept); candra (MOON — kept; moon IS the answer, never cooled). Rows: 10 (moon left standing — answer-image, no gloss), 1 (‘in my mind’ closes — sport placed last, interior). Close: ‘play ever in my mind’. Rupture: line-break (question turns to moon-answer — dissolved asked, moon answered). Rejected: ‘cool’ for moon — killed: moon is the answer; ‘delight’ for emission — killed: visarga kept emission. Read aloud: ONCE-dis-SOLVED, FIRE-formed e-MISS-ion — WHERE-would-IT-shine, JOY-be-YOND-fac-ing … MOON-touched, LOVE-ly, FIRE-and-MOON-pow-ERED — BHAI-ra-va, MAY-your e-MISS-ion PLAY-ev-ER in-MY-mind.

lines: Once dissolved, fire-formed emission — where would it shine, joy-beyond-facing?
Moon-touched, lovely, fire-and-moon-powered — Bhairava, may Your emission play ever in my mind.
